hero.title: IEEE METU NCC
hero.lead: IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers), the world's largest technical professional organization, is dedicated to advancing technology for the benefit of humanity.

section.cs: IEEE Computer Society promotes collaborative learning and creation through team projects and events in web development, game development and artificial intelligence. It offers members projects, trainings and activities providing both academic and professional development opportunities.
section.ras: IEEE RAS organizes trainings and technical events and actively participates in Teknofest competitions.
section.aess: The newly established IEEE Aerospace and Electronic Systems Society welcomes Aerospace Engineering students.

about.historyParagraph: IEEE METU NCC was founded on March 7, 2011 by Professor Ali Muhtaroğlu, Furkan Ercan and their team. Our student branch is an active organization aiming to support students' development in engineering, technology and innovation.
about.subsocietiesParagraph: Within IEEE METU NCC there are active sub-societies including RAS (Robotics & Automation Society), AESS (Aerospace & Electronic Systems Society) and CS (Computer Society). Each sub-society organizes technical trainings, seminars, workshops and social events tailored to its domain.
about.eventsParagraph: Our branch regularly participates in national technology competitions such as TEKNOFEST, proudly representing our university. In addition to events that promote technical knowledge sharing, IEEE METU NCC values projects that strengthen social collaboration.
about.visionParagraph: With the vision "Inspire. Innovate. Impact.", IEEE METU NCC continues to provide an environment where students can develop both their technical and leadership skills.

teknofest.mechatroverParagraph: Our IEEE METU NCC RAS Mechatrover team participated in the 2025 TEKNOFEST Industrial Digital Technologies Competition with a 10-person squad and achieved finalist status, proudly representing METU NCC. The competition aims to increase efficiency, quality, speed and flexibility in processes such as production, planning, stock tracking, supply, marketing, management, decision support, logistics and energy use through the digitalization of the manufacturing industry. Within this scope, teams are expected to design a fully autonomous guided robot that can move along designated paths and transport specific loads point-to-point in factory internal logistics or warehouses. As IEEE METU NCC RAS Mechatrover, we are proud to represent both our team and university on this important platform with our innovative solution.
teknofest.caleumParagraph: Our IEEE–METU CALEUM team continued its work within the Model Satellite Project launched in 2021 and achieved first place in the 2024 Model Satellite Competition. Led by Güney Tünçer, Nadir Güney Kunt and Arda Altınbilek, the project showcased our team’s engineering capabilities, interdisciplinary collaboration and interest in space technologies. This success has become one of METU NCC’s most prominent sources of pride in the national science and technology arena.

calculators.headerLead: Quick calculation tools focused on Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Everything is computed in your browser.

threephase.title: Three Phase Calculator
threephase.desc: Calculates the line and phase voltages, currents and power of a balanced three-phase system for star (Y) / delta (Δ) connected sources and loads.
threephase.note: Assumes a balanced system, abc (positive) phase sequence and ideal (zero impedance) lines. The entered voltage is converted to RMS and results are RMS; angles belong to phase a, with V<sub>an</sub> = 0° as reference.

filter.title: Passive Filter Calculator
filter.desc: Calculates the cutoff / center frequency, bandwidth and the gain at a chosen frequency for passive low pass, high pass, band pass and band stop filters.

timer555.title: 555 Timer Calculator
timer555.desc: Calculates the frequency, period and pulse width of the NE555 in astable and monostable modes.

smith.title: Smith Chart Calculator
smith.desc: Plots the load impedance on the Smith chart and calculates the reflection coefficient, VSWR and return loss. You can also click on the chart to pick an impedance.

divider.title: Voltage Divider Calculator
divider.desc: Calculates the output voltage, current and resistor power dissipation of a two-resistor voltage divider. Optionally add a load resistor connected to the output.

tau.title: RC / RL Time Constant Calculator
tau.desc: Calculates the time constant (τ), cutoff frequency and charge / discharge times of RC and RL circuits.

buck.title: Buck Converter Calculator
buck.desc: Calculates the duty cycle and the required inductor and output capacitor values for a step-down (buck) DC-DC converter.
buck.error: In a buck converter the output voltage must be lower than the input voltage.
buck.note: Assumes ideal (lossless) components and continuous conduction mode (CCM); capacitor ESR is not included.

pcbtrace.title: PCB Trace Width Calculator
pcbtrace.desc: Calculates the width a copper PCB conductor (trace) needs to carry a given current according to IPC-2152, along with its resistance, voltage drop and power loss.
pcbtrace.currentTip: The current flowing through the copper trace.
pcbtrace.thicknessTip: The copper weight of the trace; 1 oz or 2 oz is usually chosen. If you are not sure, calculate for 1 oz.
pcbtrace.riseTip: 5 °C is used for very sensitive components, 10 °C for general electronic circuits and 20 °C for circuits that tolerate high temperatures. For a safe result, calculate with 7 °C or 10 °C.
pcbtrace.ambientTip: The ambient temperature; used for the power loss calculation.
pcbtrace.lengthTip: The length of the copper trace; used for the power loss calculation.
pcbtrace.planeHelp: If you are not sure, choose "No".
pcbtrace.note: IPC-2152 is a standard published in 2009 that lets you size PCB copper traces from a curve rather than a linear formula. You can also use the more 'traditional' IPC-2221 standard, but on modern PCBs it can lead to unnecessary cost and wasted board area.
